note: Rules tied to the city map layers loaded by jobs.load_city_layers. Each switches as a data edit.

rules.rule: Lot inside the city's transit-served location map: CTA or Metra station buffer, or 1,320 ft of a bus corridor segment in Table 17-17-0400-B. Parking required = 0 for residential uses; bike parking applies.
Demolishing a residential building: surcharge of $20,000 per dwelling unit lost or $60,000 per building, whichever is greater. Sunset 2029-12-31.
rules.code: Municipal Code 2-44-135 (Northwest Side Preservation Ordinance, September 2024)
rules.caveat: The surcharge pilot areas are taken to match the two zoning special districts; confirm against the Department of Housing maps. The city's 606 shape may predate the 2025-07-16 expansion.

rules.rule: RS3: if more than 50% of lots on the same block face hold 2+ unit buildings, a detached house is not allowed and minimum lot area per unit drops to 1,500 sq ft so a two-flat fits. RT3.5: same test at 40%, requiring a two-flat or multi-unit building. Vacant lots count either way at the applicant's choice.

In RT4, RM4.5-RM6.5, B and C districts: a detached house or two-flat is allowed only if more than 50% of lots on the same block face already hold a detached house or two-flat. Otherwise build 3+ units.

RS lots inside an ADU zone may add an ADU. Limit codes: 1 = annual cap on ADU permits per block, 2 = owner must live on site, 3 = administrative adjustment needed. Outside the zones, RS lots get no ADU path.
rules.caveat: Limit code meanings are from the layer's TEXT field; check the ordinance for the annual cap number.

rules.rule: Flag only. Inside the fire limits (Halsted to the lake, Division to Roosevelt), wood-frame construction is restricted.
